Container.Name: Vora
Container.Overview: Vora is a self-hosted media server for movies, TV, music, and IPTV with DVR, with cinematic clients for Android, Android TV, Fire TV, Roku, and the web. REQUIREMENTS: Vora needs a PostgreSQL database with the pgvector extension. Install the companion "vora-postgres" template (pgvector/pgvector:pg16) FIRST, and put BOTH containers on the same user-defined Docker network (create one under Settings > Docker > Add network, e.g. "vora") so Vora can reach Postgres by container name. After both are running, browse to http://[SERVER-IP]:8080 and claim the server: the account you create there is the server admin. GPU (optional): for NVIDIA hardware transcoding, install the Nvidia-Driver plugin and set Extra Parameters to --runtime=nvidia.
Container.Requires: Requires a PostgreSQL server with the pgvector extension (see the vora-postgres template) on the same custom Docker network.
